payload.reasoning: Verified against the live record. Entry scope: 'human-made audio codec technique built to persist as a method for reducing audio data size through perceptual or lossless encoding'. All three ACCEPTED edges are data-compression sense: SERVES digital-audio ('reduces the storage and bandwidth requirements of digital audio'), DEPENDS_ON signal-processing ('transform coding, quantization, and entropy encoding... no mechanism to reduce data size'), DEPENDS_ON spectral-representation ('MP3, AAC, Opus use spectral-representation... FFT/MDCT... psychoacoustic masking or frequency-domain quantization'). The accepted v1 definition instead carves DYNAMIC RANGE compression (threshold/ratio/attack/release/knee) — the carve that belongs to the compressor/DRC effect entries, not to audio-compression. Under Law 11d the pinned sense leaves the entry's own scope and accepted edges homeless: DEFINITION_FAILS_TO_CARVE is the correct defect. The proposed replacement carves data compression coherently: parameters (codec family, bitrate/quality, CBR/VBR mode, psychoacoustic model, container), mechanism (spectral analysis, masking thresholds, quantization plus entropy coding, decodable bitstream), persistence (encoders/decoders, streaming services, ISO/IEC and ITU specifications), with a well-formed Law 6 trailer. It is specific, not a generic template, and matches the scope sentence almost term-for-term. No sense is lost: dynamic range compression already has its own entries on the map. The challenge should be upheld: the v1 definition falls and the replacement seats.
